name: Xichang LC-3
tagline: First operational CZ-3 launch pad — DFH-2 first comsat, Apstar / Asiasat / Sinosat era
description: Xichang LC-3 hosted the maiden Long March 3 flight in April 1984, which placed the DFH-2 'Dong Fang Hong-2' communications satellite into geostationary transfer orbit — China's first GTO success. Through the 1990s it supported many Apstar, Asiasat, and Sinosat commercial communications launches. Today it remains in active use alongside LC-2 for Long March 3B operations.
best_known_for: First Chinese GTO success (1984) + comsat workhorse
